name: ctu-competition-hub
description: CTU Competition Hub - Enterprise-Grade MERN Stack Competition Management Platform for CT University

scripts.build:server: esbuild server/src/server.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node18 --format=esm --packages=external --outfile=api/index.js && esbuild server/src/app.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node18 --format=esm --packages=external --outfile=server/app.js && esbuild server/src/app.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node18 --format=esm --packages=external --outfile=app.js
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --workspace=server && npm install --workspace=client
